title: Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE)
prompt: Apply rotary position embeddings to adjacent coordinate pairs of (...,L,D) arrays. D must be even; positions is length L. Preserve pairwise Euclidean norms.

resources.title: RoPE Clearly Explained
resources.why: Visual walk-through of how rotating query and key pairs makes attention depend on relative position.

resources.title: Rotary Embeddings: A Relative Revolution
resources.why: Derives RoPE from complex rotations and shows why the dot product keeps only the relative offset.
